questions.text: A, B, C, D, E, F and G live on seven different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. B lives on the third floor. Only two persons live between B and D. Only one person live between D and A. Only one person lives between F and C but C does not live on the topmost floor. G lives immediately below E. On which floor number does E live?

Each of G, H, I, J, K, L and M has an exam on a different day of a week starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. G has an exam on Wednesday. Only two persons have exam between G and L. I has exam immediately before L. H's exam is not on the last day. J has exam immediately after K. On which day does M have the exam?
